The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 4.50 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

The judge's explanation, as written

Rider and driver: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full. The facts: the trip record (EV-TRIP-02726) shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 07:18:21 and cancelled at 07:22:54 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, with the free waiting period in force for this trip at 180 seconds (platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02726) shows no qualifying fix inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius until 07:20:21 — 120 seconds after the tap — and the driver's one continuous in-geofence hold runs 07:20:21 to 07:22:51, i.e. 150 seconds, ending 3 seconds before the cancellation. Why the fee is refunded: POL-NS-01(c) measures the required dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'arrived' tap and not from the wait timer that tap starts, and 150 seconds is 30 seconds short of 180. POL-NS-06 makes the fee not chargeable where the effective in-geofence dwell falls short of the free waiting period and refunds it in full whether or not the rider was present or responded. The refund figure is the cancellation-fee line of EV-FARE-02726, SGD 4.50, which is also the entire sum charged (base fare, platform fee and tolls all SGD 0.00; payment status CHARGED; nothing previously refunded). On the driver's arguments: limbs (a) and (d) of POL-NS-01 are met and the hold is indeed one unbroken 150-second interval — both accepted. The argument that the trip record's own timer (07:18:23 to 07:22:54, 271 seconds) is a second admissible measurement requiring escalation under POL-NS-09(b) is rejected: POL-NS-09(b) escalates only where no clause resolves the conflict, and POL-NS-01(c) resolves it by naming the GPS clock as the measure. POL-NS-12, which would let the platform's own arrival and timer events stand independently, applies only where the arrival marker is GPS_AUTO; this trip's marker is BUTTON, so it is expressly unavailable. The driver's own statement that he 'pressed arrived a bit early' is consistent with the trace. Whether the marker is treated as false under POL-NS-05 or limb (b) simply fails for want of an in-geofence fix at or before the tap, the measured in-geofence dwell is 150 seconds against 180 on either reading. Because POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-01, POL-NS-07 pays nothing and driver_compensation_sgd is null; the anti-farming check would not have tripped in any event (2 no-show terminations against 94 completed trips in 30 days, below both the count and the rate threshold). The 80 percent figure of SGD 3.60 the driver asks for is therefore not payable. On the rider's arguments: POL-NS-04 assists neither side here — the only chat message is the driver's and the rider's own track sits about 740 m from the pin — but that is immaterial, because POL-NS-06 does not depend on the rider's presence or response. The fare line reconciles with the platform's published fee, both SGD 4.50, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged, and nothing carrying the deciding fact is impaired: the GPS trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 100% coverage, no gaps and 88 fixes, and the trip record is COMPLETE at weight 1.0. The missing traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02726-01 (status MISSING, weight 0.0) carries no fact; its absence is cited only because it forecloses summing separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i), a route that is unavailable here, so the 150-second dwell stands unaccumulated. No other artifact falls below weight 1.0, so no POL-GEN-02(3) discount is applied. No referral is issued: POL-NS-05 records a false-arrival referral only in limbs (ii) and (iii) — where no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere, or where the corrected dwell still meets the minimum — and neither applies; limb (i), which does apply (corrected dwell 150 s below the 180 s free period), directs the refund without a referral, and no other clause in force produces one. Confidence is 0.9: the deciding fact — the 150-second in-geofence dwell against the 180-second requirement — is carried by EV-GPS-02726 and EV-TRIP-02726, both at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold of POL-GEN-05, so the refund executes on issue; the ruling is provisional and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and its limb (b) fails on the driver's own trace. The trip record timestamps the 'arrived' event at 07:18:21, but the trace's arrival block places the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 07:20:21 — 120 seconds later — and only 16 of the driver's 88 fixes fall inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius at all. There is no admissible in-radius fix at or before the arrival marker, and none within 400 m of the pin at that time that could route this to POL-NS-03. Either limb (b) fails outright, or the clock recomputes under POL-NS-05 and limb (c) fails on the 150 second dwell. On either reading the driver had not arrived when he said he had, and the cancellation fee is not chargeable.

evidence EV-TRIP-02726, EV-GPS-02726 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02

kept Limb (c) also fails, and the arithmetic is the platform's own. The continuous in-geofence dwell required is the free waiting period in force for this trip, 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec on EV-TRIP-02726, and the STANDARD minimum_dwell_sec the trace's own arrival block reports), and the trace reports the driver's longest qualifying run as 150 seconds, running 07:20:21 to 07:22:51 — a shortfall of 30 seconds. POL-NS-06 therefore makes the fee not chargeable: the 4.50 cancellation fee is refunded in full and no driver compensation is payable.

evidence EV-GPS-02726, EV-TRIP-02726 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01

kept The driver's early tap and the platform's wait timer do not rescue the fee. He states in his own words that he 'pressed arrived a bit early', and POL-NS-01(c) measures the dwell from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix, not from the 'arrived' event or from the timer that event starts. The arrival_marker on this trip is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed-arrival route is expressly unavailable to him and the platform's wait-timer events are not an independent carrier of arrival or dwell. The 271 seconds between the timer starting at 07:18:23 and the cancellation at 07:22:54 is not the dwell the policy measures; the measured dwell is 150 seconds.

evidence EV-TRIP-02726, EV-GPS-02726 · clauses POL-NS-01, POL-NS-12

kept The arrival marker is unsupported by any admissible position. The trace shows no qualifying fix within the 50 m radius before 07:20:21, and the driver's in-app message 'im at the pickup point' was sent at 07:18:41 and read at 07:19:11 — roughly 100 seconds before he was inside the geofence — so the rider was told the driver was at the pin while the trace places him elsewhere. On POL-NS-05's recomputed clock the corrected dwell is 150 seconds, below the 180 second free waiting period, so limb (i) returns the fee in full with no compensation, and the trip should carry a false-arrival referral so the pattern is visible to human review.

evidence EV-GPS-02726, EV-CHAT-02726, EV-TRIP-02726 · clauses POL-NS-05, POL-NS-01

kept The rider's own position is immaterial to this refund, and I do not argue POL-NS-04. The chat log holds a single message and it is the driver's, so limb (a) of POL-NS-04 is not met; and the rider's track sits about 740 m from the pin throughout, so limb (c) would fail on admissible fixes. That does not matter, because POL-NS-06 is drafted as strict liability — it refunds the fee whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded to messages. The case is decided on the driver's own dwell of 150 seconds against a 180 second minimum.

evidence EV-CHAT-02726, EV-GPS-02726, EV-TRIP-02726 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-04

kept The driver cannot make up the 30 seconds by accumulation. The trace reports a single in-geofence interval — run_count 1, accumulated dwell 150 seconds, no excursions, no second interval — and POL-NS-06(i) permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a traffic advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covers the pickup road and the waiting window. EV-ADVIS-02726-01 is MISSING: no payload, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, and the trace block records limb (i) as unavailable for that reason. I disclose the impairment and rely on it only for the absence itself, which is citable: limb (i) cannot run on this record, and asserting a missing advisory in the driver's favour would engage POL-NS-09 rather than exonerate him. The 150 second dwell stands unaccumulated.

evidence EV-GPS-02726, EV-ADVIS-02726-01 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-09

kept The money is uncontested and the refund is the cancellation-fee line only. The fare breakdown charges a 4.50 cancellation fee and nothing else — base fare 0.00, platform fee 0.00, no tolls, no surcharge — with payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the whole 4.50 the rider contests has been taken from her and is returned in full under POL-NS-06 read with POL-GEN-03's definition of FULL_REFUND.

evidence EV-FARE-02726 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-GEN-03

The driver advocate

kept The driver was at the pin, not 'far away on the main road'. The trace carries 16 consecutive position fixes with reported accuracy of 25 m or better inside the 50 m arrival radius fixed for a STANDARD pickup zone, the nearest of them 0.35 m from the pin, so the arrival test in POL-NS-02 is met on the driver's own evidence and the rider's account of where the driver was is contradicted by the record.

evidence EV-GPS-02726, EV-TRIP-02726 · clauses POL-NS-02

kept Two of POL-NS-01's four limbs are on the record and are not in dispute. Limb (a) is met by the 'driver_arrived' event at 07:18:21, and limb (d) is met because the trip shows no boarding event and was terminated by the driver at 07:22:54 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, a code limb (d) recognises. This was not a driver who abandoned the booking; it was a driver who ended it for a rider who did not appear.

evidence EV-TRIP-02726 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The driver's in-geofence presence is a single unbroken hold, not a circling driver. The derived arrival block finds exactly one in-geofence interval — 16 qualifying fixes running from 07:20:21 to 07:22:51, run_count 1, no excursion recorded past the 300 m leash — and the cancellation at 07:22:54 falls three seconds after that hold ends, so there is no second interval to sum and nothing fragmented about the wait. The driver does not dispute that the exported trace measures that one hold at 150 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period in force; his case is not that this arithmetic is wrong but that the record carries a competing measurement of the same wait, which is his next point.

evidence EV-GPS-02726, EV-TRIP-02726 · clauses POL-NS-01

kept The record carries two admissible measurements of the same wait and they do not agree. The trip record's own platform telemetry starts the free waiting clock at 07:18:23 and records the cancellation at 07:22:54 — 271 seconds, 91 seconds beyond the 180 second free period — while the exported trace's derived arrival block starts the qualifying in-geofence run only at 07:20:21, 120 seconds after the arrival marker (dwell_start_offset_sec -120), and measures 150 seconds. POL-NS-05 decides the arrival marker on a specific pair of numbers, the driver's distance from the pin and his speed at the arrival timestamp, and the exported derived facts report neither, so the false-marker test cannot be run on this record. Two admissible artifacts therefore conflict directly on arrival and dwell with no clause resolving the conflict on these facts, which is the situation POL-NS-09(b) addresses: the fee should be held for a human reviewer rather than refunded.

evidence EV-TRIP-02726, EV-GPS-02726 · clauses POL-NS-09, POL-NS-05, POL-NS-01

kept The rider was not at the pickup point. His own track carries 60 fixes, every one of them between 735.9 m and 742.8 m from the pin, and not one fix inside the 100 m rider presence radius for a STANDARD zone. Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 therefore fails affirmatively and the rider cannot be exonerated by that clause; his complaint is about the timing of the driver's marker, not about his own attendance, which the record shows he never gave.

evidence EV-GPS-02726, EV-TRIP-02726 · clauses POL-NS-04, POL-NS-02

kept The rider never opened a channel of his own. The chat log holds one message and it is the driver's — 'im at the pickup point', sent at 07:18:41, delivered and read by the rider at 07:19:11 — and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. POL-NS-04 requires a locating or coordinating message from the rider and a driver's failure to answer it; with no rider message at all and no in-app call, limbs (a) and (b) cannot be satisfied, and the only coordination on this trip came from the driver.

evidence EV-CHAT-02726, EV-TRIP-02726 · clauses POL-NS-04

kept There is no integrity defect for the rider to exploit. The cancellation-fee line of the fare breakdown is SGD 4.50, identical to the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd carried by the trip record, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged, and every artifact in this bundle is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 apart from the advisory that is MISSING, so nothing carrying the deciding facts is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) and no POL-GEN-02 discount and no POL-NS-09(e) escalation arises out of the evidence layer.

evidence EV-FARE-02726, EV-TRIP-02726, EV-GPS-02726 · clauses POL-NS-08, POL-GEN-02

kept EV-ADVIS-02726-01 is MISSING — issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0 — and is cited only as the absence it is: no traffic advisory covered the pickup road in this window. That absence means POL-NS-06(i) cannot be used to accumulate dwell (the derived accumulation block records the limb as unavailable), and it equally means that no kerb restriction, enforcement operation, closure or accident explains the termination; no limb that requires a populated advisory can be asserted on this record, and asserting one against a MISSING artifact would itself engage POL-NS-09.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02726-01 · clauses POL-NS-06, POL-NS-09

kept If the judge finds the fee chargeable, the remedy the driver asks for is not NO_ACTION but DRIVER_COMPENSATION. POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the net fee in force, SGD 3.60 of the SGD 4.50 charged — the same figure the payments ledger already computes — and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, under the 4 the check needs, and 2 against 94 completed trips is 2.1 percent, under the 8 percent second limb, so the payout may not be withheld and no other profile field bears on the point.

evidence EV-DPROF-02726, EV-FARE-02726 · clauses POL-NS-07, POL-GEN-03, POL-GEN-01
